content_variants.text:
Woman inj*ured in bombardment | Factions target regime positions in Lattakia countryside

An elder woman was injured in artillery shelling by the regime on the vicinity of Al-Atareb City in western Aleppo countryside, and regime forces fired mortar shells on the vicinity of Folaifal Village in southern of Idlib.

On the same context, opposition factions shelled regime positions on Ain Al-Ashra frontlines in northern Lattakia countryside. However, no casualties have been reported yet.

Yesterday, a regime soldier was killed and three civilians were injured in shelling with heavy artillery by factions of “Al-Fath Al-Mubin” operation room, on Jurin Town in Sahl Al-Ghab in western Hama countryside.

On the same context, regime forces shelled Jisr Al-Shughour City in Idlib countryside with several shells, amid information regarding the presence of injuries among civilians.

“Zobair Bin Al-Awam” Brigade that belongs to HTS fired mortar shells on “Dashma” of the regime forces in Jubas Village in eastern Idlib countryside.

Moreover, HTS fired rockets on sites and positions of the regime forces in Tel Dadikh eastern of Idlib.
